title: status
description: v1.0 — per-report status JSON written at the end of every pipeline run. Two consumers: (1) the Fleet View builder reads every status file and renders one card per report on the index page; (2) the Insights agent reads its own previous run's status for cross-week continuity (see DECISIONS.md entries 8 and 22). The file is self-contained so the Fleet View card needs only this one file per report to render. Schema locked 2026-05-21.

schema_version.description: Version tag so consumers can handle future shape changes.

report_id.description: Internal stable identifier for the report (matches the config file name and the verifier_report.json's report_id).

customer.description: Customer name. Used by the Fleet View builder to group cards.

report_display_name.description: Human-readable card title shown on the Fleet View.

week_end.description: The last day of the week this status reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Identifies which week's report this is.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this status file was written (i.e., when the pipeline finished).

dashboard_path.description: Relative path from the project root to the rendered dashboard HTML. The Fleet View card uses this to link out.

status.description: Outcome of this pipeline run at the end (after the auto-fix loop). Mirrors verifier_report.status. pass = clean ship; warn = published with override(s); fail = halted, dashboard NOT generated. See DECISIONS.md entry 18.

summary.description: Warning counts for quick card formatting. Matches verifier_report.summary.

warnings.description: Copied verbatim from verifier_report.warnings so the Fleet View card is self-contained (one file per card to read). Item shape is the same as verifier_report.schema.json.

headline.description: The headline rate for the latest complete week this status covers. Read by next week's Insights agent for light continuity (Decision 8).

trend.description: The trend signal for the per-week rate (OLS slope per Decision 6). Read by next week's Insights agent for continuity.

direction.description: Categorical trend direction derived from the slope sign and the methodology's flat threshold.

slope.description: Numeric slope value (e.g. -0.3 means the rate is decreasing by 0.3 per week).
